Pandora reports 6% Q3 organic growth and an EBIT margin of 15.9%, matching last year's organic growth rate. The margin rose 190bp, with 370bp from a one-off US tariff refund; Pandora calls the rest of the move broadly flat. 2026 guidance narrows to 2-3% organic growth and a 22.5-23% EBIT margin, both up from wider ranges. Petra Diamonds shareholders cannot trade their shares after the FCA suspended its London listing on 2 November. Petra missed its 31 October audit deadline; the group says the audit is still in progress and restoration will not be automatic. Two major holders, Terris Fund and Azvalor, saw their stakes fall to 27.04% and 13.93% only because Petra issued 19.2 million new shares in July. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
